interest: Shows Japan's reliance on old Meiji-era protocol manuals into the 1930s, with State seeking comparative ceremonial data.
overview: Despatch (1934): Grew identifies Japan's 1905 and 1923 protocol manuals on receiving foreign ambassadors, noting both are out of print and asking if Washington retains copies.

subfiles.about: Ambassador Joseph C. Grew reports to the Secretary of State on the availability of Japanese official publications regarding diplomatic protocol and imperial court etiquette.
subfiles.summary: Grew reports Japan's key protocol publications - an 1923 ambassadors' manual and a 1905 imperial court guide - are both out of print, hoping Washington kept copies.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 653 from Joseph C. Grew to Secretary of State on Procurement of Data Relating to Ceremonial
